title: Listing-based location autocomplete (no Google Places) for public search

requirements.summary: Replace public search Location autocomplete to use stored-property suggestions only and prevent any Google Places API loading/querying for this typeahead.
acceptanceCriteria: Typing in the Location field shows an autocomplete dropdown populated from the backend stored-property suggestions (location + title) rather than Google Places suggestions.
The frontend does not attempt to load or query Google Places Autocomplete for the public search location typeahead (even if VITE_GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY is present).
Selecting a suggestion fills the Location input with the selected suggestion text and keeps existing mouse + keyboard selection behavior (arrow keys, enter, escape).
All user-facing text remains in English (e.g., loading state, error state, empty state, helper text).

file_operations.description: Update the orchestration hook to exclusively use the backend stored-property autocomplete (property.location + property.title) and remove/disable all Google Places logic so the hook never triggers Google script loading or Google suggestion queries for public search.

Adjust the Location field to use the backend-only suggestions metadata (loading/error/empty states) and update helper text to reflect stored-property suggestions only while preserving existing keyboard and mouse dropdown interactions.
